mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_programming_question_config (question_id,language_code,starter_code,input_description,output_description,sample_explanation,constraints_text,notes_text,time_limit_seconds,memory_limit_kb,max_processes,max_file_size_kb,max_output_kb,enabled,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) VALUES (#{questionId},'python',#{starterCode},#{inputDescription},#{outputDescription},#{sampleExplanation},#{constraintsText},#{notesText},#{timeLimitSeconds},#{memoryLimitKb},#{maxProcesses},#{maxFileSizeKb},#{maxOutputKb},#{enabled},#{createBy},NOW(),#{updateBy},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE starter_code=VALUES(starter_code),input_description=VALUES(input_description),output_description=VALUES(output_description),sample_explanation=VALUES(sample_explanation),constraints_text=VALUES(constraints_text),notes_text=VALUES(notes_text),time_limit_seconds=VALUES(time_limit_seconds),memory_limit_kb=VALUES(memory_limit_kb),max_processes=VALUES(max_processes),max_file_size_kb=VALUES(max_file_size_kb),max_output_kb=VALUES(max_output_kb),enabled=VALUES(enabled),update_by=VALUES(update_by),update_time=NOW()

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_programming_draft (student_id,lesson_id,question_id,source_code,update_time) VALUES (#{studentId},#{lessonId},#{questionId},#{sourceCode},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_code=VALUES(source_code),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_programming_submission WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND lesson_id=#{lessonId} AND question_id=#{questionId} AND submission_key=#{submissionKey}

mapper.update: UPDATE biz_programming_submission SET status_code='JUDGING',status_message='判题中',judged_at=#{judgingAt} WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status_code='WAITING'

UPDATE biz_programming_submission SET status_code=#{statusCode},status_message=#{statusMessage},score=#{score},passed_case_count=#{passedCaseCount},total_case_count=#{totalCaseCount},judge0_token=#{judge0Token},judge0_status_id=#{judge0StatusId},time_seconds=#{timeSeconds},memory_kb=#{memoryKb},error_summary=#{errorSummary},judged_at=#{judgedAt} WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status_code IN ('WAITING','JUDGING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_programming_submission_case (submission_id,test_case_id,is_public,status_code,judge0_status_id,time_seconds,memory_kb,output_text,error_summary) VALUES (#{submissionId},#{testCaseId},#{isPublic},#{statusCode},#{judge0StatusId},#{timeSeconds},#{memoryKb},#{outputText},#{errorSummary}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status_code=VALUES(status_code),judge0_status_id=VALUES(judge0_status_id),time_seconds=VALUES(time_seconds),memory_kb=VALUES(memory_kb),output_text=VALUES(output_text),error_summary=VALUES(error_summary)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_programming_submission_case WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND is_public='1' ORDER BY submission_case_id
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_programming_submission SET status_code='CANCELLED',status_message='已取消',cancelled_at=#{cancelledAt} WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status_code='WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_programming_submission ps INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=ps.student_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE ps.lesson_id=#{lessonId} AND ps.question_id=#{questionId} AND ps.status_code IN ('WAITING','JUDGING') AND u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND s.entry_year=#{entryYear} AND s.class_code=#{classCode}
SELECT * FROM biz_programming_submission WHERE status_code IN ('WAITING','JUDGING') AND submitted_at < #{before} ORDER BY submitted_at LIMIT #{limit}
